mapper.select: SELECT c.city_id, c.city_number, c.createtime, c.updatetime, SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.MerName, ',', -1) AS city_name FROM city c LEFT JOIN sysregion r ON r.id = c.city_number AND r.Level = 2 ORDER BY c.city_id

SELECT c.city_id, c.city_number, c.createtime, c.updatetime, SUBSTRING_INDEX(r.MerName, ',', -1) AS city_name FROM city c LEFT JOIN sysregion r ON r.id = c.city_number AND r.Level = 2 WHERE c.city_id = #{cityId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO city (city_number, createtime, updatetime) VALUES (#{cityNumber}, #{createtime}, #{updatetime})
